# GroupDocs.Redaction documentation

Markdown sources for https://docs.groupdocs.com/redaction/.

Java section: https://docs.groupdocs.com/redaction/java/

Java package: com.groupdocs:groupdocs-redaction
Maven repository: https://releases.groupdocs.com/java/repo/

Start here for Java:

- java/_index.md
- java/getting-started/installation.md
- java/getting-started/supported-document-formats.md
- java/getting-started/sdk-cloud-mcp.md

Examples: https://github.com/groupdocs-redaction/GroupDocs.Redaction-for-Java
API reference: https://reference.groupdocs.com/redaction/java/
Product page: https://products.groupdocs.com/redaction/
Releases: https://releases.groupdocs.com/redaction/java/release-notes/

Python section: https://docs.groupdocs.com/redaction/python-net/
Python package: groupdocs-redaction-net (PyPI); pip also installs groupdocs-shared-net

Start here for Python:

- python-net/_index.md
- python-net/getting-started/installation.md
- python-net/getting-started/supported-document-formats.md
- python-net/agents-and-llm-integration.md

Python examples: https://github.com/groupdocs-redaction/GroupDocs.Redaction-for-Python-via-.NET
Python API reference: https://reference.groupdocs.com/redaction/python-net/
Python releases: https://releases.groupdocs.com/redaction/python-net/release-notes/

Other platform folders in this repo (net, nodejs-java, python-net, mcp) stay in place.
Do not invent a format count. Read the Java format matrix, or the Python one for Python.
MCP server (link only): https://github.com/groupdocs-redaction/GroupDocs.Redaction.Mcp
